mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate directly correlates with deteriorating corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100.0 signals imminent recession, triggering negative equity returns as manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate revenue growth and profit margins.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 but 20d returns positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as sectoral downturns amplify corporate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: HOUST < 970 and INDPRO < 100.0 but 60d returns positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215.0) trigger monetary tightening expectations, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as real interest rates rise.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 215.0 but 20d returns positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining real assets (RSAFS) reflect reduced consumer spending capacity, directly causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as retail and service sector revenue growth stalls.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 370000.0 but 5d returns positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment decline below 137,000 thousand signals labor market contraction, driving negative equity returns as hiring freezes reduce corporate profitability and earnings growth.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 137000.0 but 20d returns positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 11700.0) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215.0) indicate stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as growth and inflation pressures combine to reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 < 11700.0 and CPIAUCSL > 215.0 but 60d returns positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.0%) indicate accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as financing costs remain low.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.0% but 5d returns positive in ≤ 40% of instances.
